description: The Buddy list client (M15, docs/design/architecture.md) draws its own title bars, so its windows may move, minimize, maximize and close themselves: the drag region needs start-dragging, and the title bar's buttons need the rest. Nothing else is added. The list window keeps the label `main` in both clients, so today's client is granted these too; it never calls them. Other window kinds (chat, settings) get their own entries when they exist. Interface size zooms the page and grows the window to match (core/appearance.ts), which needs set-webview-zoom and set-size.
